senses.gloss: m.(b. h. חֹב; חבב)bosom, trnsf. the full ramification of a tree, opp. חוּד the point, the body of the tree reaching above the main branches.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 81a:9">B. Kam. 81ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>חוּבּוֹ של אילן</he> Ar., Ms. H. a. F. (Rashi version: <he>חיבו</he>; ed. <cite ref="A01121"><he>אִיבּוֹ</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="A00016"><he>אֵב</he></cite>).

senses.gloss: seam, rim.—Pl. חוּבִּין. Ib. 119ᵇ top ולא … שלשה ח׳ he must not use (of the cloth for stretching and hackling) more than three widths of a seam; [Tosef. ib. XI, 13 ed. Zuck. חכין, also some Mss. B. Kam. l. c., Ms. F. a. R. חֻבִּין, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l., note; v. חַכָּה].
